hyperedges.label: Requirement to Human Scenario Review Flow

nodes.label: SCRIPT_ERROR-Only Repair Gate
nodes.rationale: Test repair requires an exact triage checksum, SCRIPT_ERROR classification, consecutive revision, and no more than three attempts.

nodes.label: Sanitized Scoped Memory
nodes.rationale: Run history and lessons are sanitized, immutable, exact-scope, checksum-bound, human-approved, and advisory to current requirements.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Authentication Preflight
nodes.rationale: Credential smoke is allowed only after exact scenario and generated-test quality checks, origin authorization, environment references, Chromium availability, and safe output and evidence policies pass.

nodes.label: Progressive Browser Execution Plan
nodes.rationale: Execution advances through static preflight, Chromium credential smoke, Chromium scenarios, remaining browsers, and bounded affected reruns.

nodes.label: Shared Provider Safety Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code adapters must preserve identical roles, skills, human gates, repair rules, read-only target boundaries, secret handling, and final human review stop.

nodes.label: Atomic Requirement Classification
nodes.rationale: Normalized statements retain source coordinates and are explicitly classified as stated requirements, assumptions, or observations.

nodes.label: Human Clarification Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Only recorded human answers may change canonical requirements; impact metadata remains separate from the new canonical revision.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Playwright Preflight
nodes.rationale: Generation validates origins, environment references, renderer compatibility, locator configuration, and plan completeness before emitting executable test source.

nodes.label: Complete Browser Matrix Evidence
nodes.rationale: Smoke and all configured browsers must register the same run's expected candidates with nonempty evidence and executed outcomes.

nodes.label: Exact-Revision Scenario Approval Gate
nodes.rationale: Playwright implementation is reachable only after validation of the exact evaluated and human-approved scenario revision.

nodes.label: Bounded SCRIPT_ERROR Repair
nodes.rationale: Only SCRIPT_ERROR permits a next-revision test repair, while preserving the prior revision and allowing no more than three repairs.

nodes.label: Approved Advisory Memory
nodes.rationale: Future runs use only approved, non-stale, exact-scope knowledge and disclose its advisory influence while current requirements remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Improvement Trigger Policy
nodes.rationale: Three similar cross-task findings, one severe failure, or an explicit human request may trigger a separately approved improvement proposal.

nodes.label: Progressive Browser Execution
nodes.rationale: Execution progresses from static preflight through disposable Chromium credential smoke, Chromium scenarios, remaining browsers, and policy-authorized reruns.

nodes.label: Independent Scenario Evaluation Gate
nodes.rationale: Projection parity, schema, references, and checksum validate before independent evaluation; only exact-revision PASS reaches human review.

nodes.label: Fresh Test Evaluation Context
nodes.rationale: The evaluator receives the exact generated-test checksum without author reasoning, cannot edit tests, and invalidates its result after material changes.

nodes.label: Bounded Stage Handoff
nodes.rationale: The coordinator retains exact workflow state and references, invokes the next authoritative role, and cannot reuse its context as a specialist fallback.

nodes.label: Rollback-Safe Policy Improvement
nodes.rationale: Improvement proposals require exact evidence, human policy approval, regression cases, shadow evaluation, and preserved rollback evidence before adoption.

nodes.label: Policy-Bounded Capability Extension
nodes.rationale: One policy-approved low-risk locator capability may be implemented per run with contract, renderer, focused tests, and an audit record; sensitive capabilities remain human-gated.

nodes.label: READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW Gate
nodes.rationale: Only an exact READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW assessment opens final human review, without granting final approval or erasing residual risk.

nodes.label: Evidence-Backed Defect Candidate
nodes.rationale: A product-defect candidate requires reproduction, exact approved expectations, the intended condition, and ruled-out script, environment, data, and authentication causes.

nodes.label: Policy-Driven Routine Autonomy
nodes.rationale: Human decisions remain reserved for intent and authority, while agents may apply but never expand, weaken, or self-approve existing low-risk policy.

nodes.label: Untrusted Evidence Boundary
nodes.rationale: Documents, applications, logs, tools, generated artifacts, and examples are data whose embedded instructions cannot change authority, gates, or secret handling.

nodes.label: Immutable Exact-Revision Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Accepted artifacts are immutable, material changes create new revisions and invalidate downstream artifacts, and human approvals reference exact revisions and checksums.

nodes.label: Independent Scenario Evaluation
nodes.rationale: A fresh evaluator checks coverage, feasibility, observability, state, cleanup, and traceability and cannot edit scenarios or create human approval.

nodes.label: Human-Approved Project Knowledge
nodes.rationale: Reusable lessons are sanitized, narrowly scoped, evidence-backed, and advisory until separately approved by a human.

nodes.label: Requirement Clarification Gate
nodes.rationale: Blocking contradictions, omissions, ambiguity, or uncertain taxonomy placement pause progression until recorded human answers create a new requirement revision.

nodes.label: Failure Classification Gate
nodes.rationale: Only an exact SCRIPT_ERROR triage authorizes bounded test-code repair; product defects and other classifications never authorize application changes.

nodes.label: Complete Quality Workflow
nodes.rationale: The workflow orders requirement analysis, independent scenario evaluation, human approval, Playwright execution, classified repair, final assessment, and final human review so no agent can bypass authority gates.

nodes.label: Human Authorization Gates
nodes.rationale: Human decisions remain mandatory for material ambiguity, scenario approval, external impact, policy changes, and final acceptance.

nodes.label: Artifact Revision Integrity
nodes.rationale: Artifacts, evaluations, and approvals use exact revisions, references, provenance, and semantic checksums to prevent stale downstream use.

nodes.label: Canonical Harness Integrity
nodes.rationale: Schema parsing, canonical serialization, and semantic checksumming form one fail-closed pipeline because review discipline alone cannot prevent stale approvals or path collisions.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Playwright Preflight
nodes.rationale: Typed actions, origin checks, a Chromium smoke, and complete browser evidence constrain execution without arbitrary browser JavaScript.

nodes.label: Runtime Artifact Isolation
nodes.rationale: Ad-hoc generated tests and evidence remain ignored run artifacts; tracked promotion requires a distinct human publication record.

nodes.label: Policy-Driven Agent Autonomy
nodes.rationale: Routine deterministic mechanics can be automatic while intent, authority, sensitive capabilities, and policy evolution remain human-gated.

nodes.label: Capability Extension Classifier
nodes.rationale: Only one deterministic locator-based interaction or assertion per run may be auto-approved when all sensitive flags are false.
